So if we put both in Y3S2, we are done? Wait, the student said "Finishing as soon as possible". If Y3S2 is the last semester with courses, that's semester 6. But the student is in Y3S1 (Sem 5). So Sem 5: CS3227, MA2116. Sem 6: CS3263, CS2105. This satisfies all hard constraints. CS3263 in Y3S2? Yes. CS3227 in Y3S1? Yes. CS3263 and CS2105 same semester? Yes. CS2105 in Sem 8? Hard constraint says CS3227 in Y3S1, CS3263 in Y3S2. So they can't be same semester. This is a conflict between hard constraints and soft wishes. Hard constraints win. "Ideally CS32105 and CS3227 go in the same semester." Hard constraint says CS3227 in Y3S1. CS32105? No, CS2105. CS2105 in Y3S1? If CS2105 is in Y3S1, then CS3263 must also be in Y3S1 (same semester constraint). But CS3263 must be in Y3S2. Contradiction. So the hard constraints "CS3263 in Y3S2" and "CS3263 and CS2105 same semester" imply CS2105 in Y3S2. "CS3227 in Y3S1". So CS3227 and CS2105 are in different semesters. The soft wish "CS2105 and CS3227 same semester" is impossible. The soft wish "CS3263 and CS3227 same semester" is impossible. The soft wish "CS2105 in Sem 8" is impossible because it must be in Sem 6 to be with CS3263. So the plan is Sem 5: CS3227, MA2116. Sem 6: CS3263, CS2105. Is MA2116 required? Yes, for CS3263. Is MA2116 open? Yes. Prereq for MA2116: MA1312 or MA1505 or MA1511 or MA1521 or MA2002. Student has MA1521. OK. So the plan exists. Why did I think NO_PLAN? I missed that MA2116 can be added. This is earlier than Sem 8. So this is the optimal plan. The soft wishes are not met, but hard constraints are. Status PLAN.
